description: I'm a HighSchool student looking for a teammate who wants to participate and gain experience in this event. I would like to make a website that converts images to sounds.
summary: Our project consists of a Google Chrome extension that transforms visual statistical information and images of landscapes into sound and melodies through a process called data sonification. The main purpose is to make statistical information more accessible to the general public and provide another way to interpret graphics without depending entirely on visual information.
details:
Resonant Earth is a Google extension that converts visual information into sound or music through a process called data sonification. The main benefit of our project consists of bringing an extra way to interpret the information and try to make people more aware of our changing planet and appreciate its beauty better.

Resonant Earth has two main options

Graphic sonorizer:

When the program is interpreting a graphic, the sound could become sharper or deeper depending on the data. We decided that sounds should be lightly dramatic because, in this way, it could represent the danger of climatic changes.

Landscape mode

This mode converts landscape images into melodies. For this mode, we decided that the sound should be more relaxing and highlight the good things about our planet and its nature.

We explored some sound online, then chose a few of free-license sounds from Pixabay’s website. (In addition to generated audio by Claude)

The project was made with Claude, Anthropic’s AI model, which wrote the code and ran the tests. The model was Claude Sonnet 5.5

Things made from zero by claude:

  • Selection overlay
  • Service worker: captures only the selected region and handles the chart/landscape purpose.
  • Chart recognition and data extraction
  • Audio engine: all instruments (piano, violin, cello, harp, flute, jazz, vibraphone, bass, brass, drone, tense and others), the reverb, fades and the calmer filter.
  • Player and WAV exporter: play, pause, stop, replay, seek and speed.
  • Landscape mode: the image feature analysis, the mood-based composer and the “what shaped the music” explanations.
  • Popup interface: the tabs, the preview with moving marker, captions, controls and styling.

The Icon was drawn using IbisPaint
